primitives.name: Intent settlement pallet
primitives.desc: Intent settlement on Materios: requests atomically reserve a positive runtime-minimum bond; request-scoped slash tombstones preserve honest replacement, expired requests refund available reserves with explicit deficit events, fresh genesis closes legacy paths, and FRV2 fraud signatures bind each request. Signature preflight and measured weights bound verification; try-runtime checks version and cutover invariants.

primitives.name: Intent-settlement oracle pallet
primitives.desc: Threshold price oracle publishing attested median prices, with staleness and deviation guards.

primitives.name: Committee governance pallet
primitives.desc: Governance over the settlement committee: membership, thresholds and parameter changes under a root-gated origin.

primitives.name: Settlement keeper
primitives.desc: Off-chain keeper that turns voucher batches into Cardano payout transactions, waits for confirmation and files bonded settlement requests using the runtime MinSettlementBond constant.

primitives.name: Intent settlement SDK
primitives.desc: TypeScript client for building, signing and submitting settlement intents.
